crossRefs.note: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you…
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.
Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

translations.web: In the same way, you also rejoice, and rejoice with me.
translations.bsb: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.
translations.kjv: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
translations.asv: and in the same manner do ye also joy, and rejoice with me.
